update.title: Automated the browser extension reload loop
update.summary: Built a loopback bridge and browser helper that let local tools inspect unpacked extensions, queue reload or enable-state changes, and refresh the active test tab.

blocks.body:
## Put the browser-only step behind an API

Extension work still stopped at the browser after every source change: find the unpacked extension, reload it, and refresh the page under test. I split that interaction between a small loopback HTTP connector and a companion browser extension, giving local tools a way to inspect development extensions and queue those browser-only actions.

blocks.code:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Tool as Local tool
  participant Bridge as Loopback connector
  participant Helper as Browser helper
  participant Browser as Browser APIs

  Tool->>Bridge: Queue reload or refresh
  Helper->>Bridge: Sync extensions and poll
  Bridge-->>Helper: Return pending commands
  Helper->>Browser: Toggle extension and refresh tab
  Helper->>Bridge: Report result
blocks.description: The loopback service queues requests; the browser helper performs the permissioned work during its next sync.

blocks.body:
## Let the browser perform the privileged work

The helper periodically synchronizes extension metadata and asks the connector for pending commands. To reload an unpacked extension, it briefly disables and re-enables it; a combined command can then refresh the active tab and report the result. The connector stays local and holds only transient state, while the helper remains the component with browser permissions.
